learning_outcomes.text: To know the scientific foundations of materials science and the relationship between material microstructure and its macroscopic properties.
To design treatments and microstructural modification techniques.
To identify the structures of various types of materials and to know material characterization and analysis techniques.
To apply methods, procedures, and use equipment to determine the characteristic indicators of material properties of interest: breaking load, hardness, Young's modulus, etc.
To analyze and construct binary phase equilibrium diagrams.
To understand, from a broader perspective, the interrelationships between structure, properties, processing, and applications.

assessment_rules: The final grade is determined by a test exam (50%) and a problem-solving exam (50%). In the test exam, each incorrect answer deducts 1/3 of the value of a correct answer. Group work and oral presentations can provide up to 1 extra point to the final grade, applicable only if a passing grade of 5 out of 10 has been achieved from the other components.
